name: Guest houses, B&Bs and holiday-home hosts

problems.words: Airbnb and Booking.com don't sync in time and I've had two guests for the same dates
quick_ideas: Block last-minute bookings on the other platforms by hand straight away, since sync delays bite hardest on short notice
Keep one master calendar you check before accepting any direct booking.

workzap_build.text: one booking calendar across Airbnb, Booking.com and direct bookings for every unit, with an automatic alert the moment two bookings overlap.

problems.ask_first: How many units, and on how many platforms each?
problems.free_stops: How the calendars are connected and the clash rules go in the solution document.

problems.words: Cleaners don't know which units are checking out today
quick_ideas: Send each cleaner tomorrow's turnovers the evening before, so mornings don't depend on your messages
Ask for a photo of the finished unit, so you know it's ready before the guest arrives.

workzap_build.text: a daily turnover list sent to each cleaner automatically, updated when bookings change overnight, with tap-to-mark "cleaned", photo proof and turnaround times across all units.

problems.ask_first: Are your cleaners your own staff or freelancers?
problems.free_stops: The turnover flow, change alerts and photo checks are detailed in the solution document.

problems.words: Same guest questions every day: Wi-Fi, parking, where's the key
quick_ideas: Note the questions you answered most this week, since a handful usually make up most messages
Put the answers in a printed card inside each unit, so guests look there first.

workzap_build.text: a guest WhatsApp assistant that answers common questions from each unit's fact sheet day and night and passes anything else to you.

problems.ask_first: Which question wakes you up at night most often?
problems.free_stops: The fact sheet content and the hand-over rules to you are worked out in the solution document.

problems.words: Guests damage things and I can't prove it was them
quick_ideas: Ask the cleaner to photograph each unit at check-out before cleaning, so damage can be matched to a stay
Keep those photos by unit and date.

workzap_build.text: a check-out inspection with photos linked automatically to each stay, so the record is there whenever a dispute comes up.

problems.ask_first: Do you take a security deposit now?
problems.free_stops: The inspection checklist per unit type stays for the solution document.

problems.words: I don't know which unit actually makes money
quick_ideas: Put last month's payout and costs for each unit side by side once, to see which ones carry the others
Mark any unit whose costs you can't find, since that is where money usually leaks.

workzap_build.text: a unit-level profit view that pulls payouts, commissions, cleaning, utilities and supplies automatically each month.

problems.ask_first: Are the units owned, rented or managed for others?
problems.free_stops: Which costs are allocated to which unit, and how, is in the solution document.

problems.words: Owners I manage for want statements and I make them by hand in Excel
quick_ideas: Use the same layout for every owner this month, so you stop rebuilding statements
Send them all on one fixed date, so owners stop chasing.

workzap_build.text: owner statements generated automatically from each unit's bookings and costs and sent as a PDF every month.

problems.ask_first: How many owners do you report to?
problems.free_stops: Statement content and data sources are set out in the solution document.

problems.words: Towels and toiletries short in one unit, piling up in another
quick_ideas: Count linen and toiletries in every unit once, to see where stock has drifted
Move the extras to where they're short in one run.

workzap_build.text: stock per unit with par levels, updated from cleaners' turnovers, with automatic restock alerts.

problems.ask_first: Do you have one central store or supplies kept in each unit?
problems.free_stops: Par levels per unit size and the restock routine stay for the solution document.

problems.words: Freelance cleaners charge differently and I can't track what I owe
quick_ideas: Agree one written rate per turnover type with each cleaner, so payments stop being argued
Check this week's turnovers with each cleaner before paying.

workzap_build.text: a cleaner ledger that adds each completed turnover automatically and shows a running balance per cleaner.

problems.ask_first: Do you pay cleaners per turnover or by the hour?
problems.free_stops: Rate rules and settlement cycle go in the solution document.

problems.words: Repeat guests want to book direct but I've no system
quick_ideas: Ask happy guests at check-out if they'd like to hear from you directly, and note it only with their permission
Block any direct booking on your master calendar the moment it's agreed.

workzap_build.text: a direct-booking page with live availability and a deposit link, feeding the same calendar as the platforms.

problems.ask_first: Are your units in Dubai, Pakistan or Canada?
problems.free_stops: The page, deposit flow and calendar connection are designed in the solution document.

problems.words: Permit renewals for every unit are a headache
quick_ideas: Put every unit's renewal dates in one list, so none surprise you
For what is actually required, talk to the relevant authority or a licensing adviser.

workzap_build.text: a renewal tracker per unit that sends reminders automatically and keeps a document checklist for each.

problems.ask_first: How many units need renewals this year?
problems.free_stops: Reminder timing and checklist structure stay for the solution document.

never_say: Advice on holiday-home permits, DTCM rules, municipal short-term rental bylaws, strata or building rules.
Anything on tax on rental income or tenancy law.
Help running unlicensed units or listing without a required permit.
Any idea involving cameras inside guest areas.
A legal view on deposit or damage disputes.
Requests for door codes, lockbox codes, Wi-Fi passwords, guest names or ID copies.

sample_reply.person: My cleaners never know who's checking out, guests wait in the lobby and leave bad reviews. What can I do about it?
sample_reply.pi: Yes, this can be fixed, and you can start this week. 1) Send each cleaner tomorrow's turnovers the evening before, so their morning doesn't depend on your messages. 2) Ask for a photo of every finished unit, so you know it's ready before the guest arrives. Workzap can do this automatically for you: a turnover list that goes to each cleaner every day, updates itself when bookings change, and shows you which units are ready. Shall I prepare a solution document and quote for you? You can say no.
